findings.establishes: While overarching goals provide a directional sense of desired behavior, they are too broad to dictate specific actions in complex scenarios where goals might conflict; this document aims to provide concrete instructions for navigating such conflicts.

findings.establishes: Default instructions are included because, in practice, it is impractical for the model to derive answers from higher level principles on the fly and makes model behavior less predictable; specifying answers as guidelines that can be overridden improves predictability and reliability while leaving developers flexibility to remove or adapt instructions.

findings.establishes: Tool is defined as a program that can be called by the assistant to perform a specific task (e.g., retrieving web pages or generating images); typically, it is up to the assistant to determine which tool(s) are appropriate, and a system or developer message will list available tools with documentation of functionality and syntax.
